scope: Failure-safe local model lifecycle cleanup at the bounded Phase 8 submission boundary.

finding.before: Terminal cleanup was only observable after a completed execution result; a Worker, Reviewer, or Integration exception could leave an idle local model resident until daemon keep-alive expiry.
finding.risk: A failed local root could retain shared Ollama memory beyond the failed attempt and obscure the next bounded attempt's resource state.

correction.mechanism: existing OllamaModelManager.unload_idle through a finally cleanup wrapper
correction.error_semantics: cleanup is bounded evidence and never replaces the original execution exception
correction.authority_impact: none; no queue, scheduler, retry, review, integration, or Gate semantics changed

verification.failure_path_assertion: cleanup-boundary failure is projected as bounded diagnostic data without masking a completed result or an original execution failure; known Planner/Worker inventories were still observed

limitations: No new real-model root was rerun because this slice changes failure-path cleanup, not the Worker convergence premise.
Planner cleanup is available through an explicit provider inventory; no live claim is made for a caller that does not supply that inventory.
Discord real-client E2E remains externally unverified.
